resolution.note: backlog triage 2026-11-07: Improves retired delivery ceremony (briefs/review/verify/slice/deliver/worker/red-first/hardening checklist)

title: Trial risk-tiered review and parallel dispatch for one week
body:
Outcome: a one-week experiment delivers ten queued tasks with review cost tiered by changed paths (docs, tracker or tests: worker, CI and one judge; core, contracts, CI or security: full panel with red-first), review running in parallel with CI, and a stateless lead dispatching 2-4 worktrees. It is compared with the current flow on task-to-merge minutes, PRs per day and defects that reached main, and feeds the KRN-vs-plain proof.
Needs an operator exception to ADR 0014 D10 and to KRN-13 or the one-slice-per-session rule for the experiment. Source: operator 2026-11-02 asked how the lead would rebuild delivery its own way; the proposal was given in session and awaits a go-ahead.
